medicalDisclaimer.title: This is not medical advice
medicalDisclaimer.body: Figures shown here come from a prototype calculator and a synthetic data set. They are an estimate, and they are not a diagnosis. Speak to a qualified dietitian or doctor before acting on them, particularly if you are managing a health condition, are pregnant, or are feeding a child.

howItWorks.title: How Healthy360 works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps, from a target to a week you can cook or order.

tell.title: Tell us what has to be true
tell.body: Your measurements, how you move, what you are working towards, and everything you cannot or will not eat — allergies, medical restrictions, religious requirements and plain dislikes, each recorded differently because each behaves differently.

target.title: See a target, and where it came from
target.body: An energy figure and protein, carbohydrate, fat and fibre grams, with the method named and the assumptions listed. It is an estimate, and it says so.

plan.title: Fill the week
plan.body: Lock what you want to keep, regenerate what you do not, swap a meal for one that fits, and watch the day's totals move as you go.

eat.title: Cook it, or have it delivered
eat.body: Every entry is either something you make or something a kitchen brings. Mix the two however suits the week.

howItWorks.nextBody: Nothing on the marketplace needs an account.

forBusiness.title: Healthy360 for business
forBusiness.subtitle: Feeding a workforce, a clinic, a training group or a retail shelf works differently from feeding a household. These programmes are built for that.
forBusiness.programmesBody: Four ways organisations buy prepared food from the kitchens on this platform.

corporate.title: Corporate meal programmes
corporate.body: Subsidised daily meals for staff, with per-employee allowances, site delivery windows and a single monthly account.

clinic.title: Clinic bulk meals
clinic.body: Therapeutic and post-operative meal supply for clinics and care settings, specified with a dietitian and delivered against a schedule.

gym.title: Training and gym packages
gym.body: Higher-protein packages sold through a training facility, sized to a member's programme rather than to a generic plan.

wholesale.title: Wholesale prepared meals
wholesale.body: Prepared meals supplied in volume for onward sale, with agreed specifications, lead times and recurring order lines.

forBusiness.termsBody: The commercial terms an organisation agrees with a kitchen, rather than a list of prices.
forBusiness.pricingBody: Rates depend on volume, specification, delivery pattern and lead time, and are agreed per account. No consumer page carries a business price, and none is shown here.
forBusiness.prototypeNotice: This page presents the business programmes. Quotations, contract catalogues and volume pricing live behind a business account and are not part of the public marketplace.
forBusiness.enquiryBody: A quotation is priced against your organisation — volume, specification, sites and delivery pattern — so it is raised from inside a business account rather than from a public page. Sign in if you have one, or create an account and we will take it from there.

imageCredits.title: Image credits
imageCredits.intro: Photography used across Healthy360 is openly licensed and bundled with the app. Where a licence requires attribution, the credit is shown here and beside the image itself. Every photograph has been cropped to a fixed frame and re-encoded.
imageCredits.synthetic: These are stock photographs chosen to match each record — not photographs of real Healthy360 products, premises or staff. Public-domain and CC0 images require no attribution and are recorded in the project’s provenance file rather than listed here.
imageCredits.none: No image currently in use requires attribution.
